basic_info.description: Perched at the border of Russian Hill and North Beach, this beautifully renovated top-floor 2-bedroom flat offers breathtaking views of the Bay, Coit Tower, and Alcatraz. Tucked away down a peaceful garden path, the home is set over 70 feet back from the street, creating a rare sense of privacy and tranquility. Remodeled in 2018, it features wide-plank hardwood floors, a sleek modern kitchen and bath, high-end appliances, a cozy gas fireplace, in-unit laundry, updated electrical and plumbing systems, and a newer building roof. A large, finished storage room with electrical, recessed lighting, insulation, and a window to the courtyard adds incredible flexibility. The unit also includes rights to expand with a private deck directly off the primary bedroom to fully capture the stunning views. Ideally located near Washington Square Park, North Beach's vibrant dining and coffee shops, Coit Tower,  Fisherman's Wharf, SoMa, the Financial District, the Chinatown Muni station, and more!
